items.title: Jerry Jerome interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: I think Dick Hyman’s wife spoke to me about Wyoming, I might have.

ctx.x: If it’s true we’re jealous, and we want some too.

Well sure, be happy to. I don’t recall. When I broke the house down on Long Island I gave a lot of my material to the Museum of Broadcasting in New York and the New School. But I think Dick Hyman’s wife spoke to me about Wyoming, I might have.
I’ll just show you where I read that, maybe it’s true. Did you start out as a clarinetist? © Fillius Jazz Archive -2-
